cd /app && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
p='/app/submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''def run():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    if len(data) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
        raise Invalid("input too large")
    try:
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise Invalid("not utf-8")
    doc = loads_strict(text)
    return build_result(doc)'''
new = '''def run():
    try:
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    except Exception:
        # an unreadable stream carries no usable document
        raise Invalid("stdin unreadable")
    if len(data) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
        raise Invalid("input too large")
    try:
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise Invalid("not utf-8")
    doc = loads_strict(text)
    return build_result(doc)'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
print("patched")
